description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2152/32 of 05.12.2019
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory amendment to the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It contains an order that modifies existing regulations by adding exemptions for specific goods related to COVID-19 response efforts. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory amendment he is authorizing under statutory powers. The content centers on legal instruments, regulatory changes, and customs procedures, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification.
